paragraphs.text: Zurzoth is a devil leader from an unknown plane .

Successful leaders among devils , like Zurzoth, are masters of long-term mayhem. If your followers grow bored, even for just a minute, they may decide that turning on you is more entertaining than waiting for orders. Zurzoth's sieges are multi-month affairs that are the talk of the hellscape, each one bringing new innovations to devil warfare.
